indexes.expression: CREATE INDEX orders_expiration_idx ON public.orders USING btree (payment_expires_at) WHERE (status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_provider_id_uq ON public.payments USING btree (provider, provider_payment_id) WHERE (provider_payment_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX product_one_cover_uq ON public.product_images USING btree (product_id) WHERE is_cover
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reservations_one_live_per_user_variant_uq ON public.reservations USING btree (user_id, launch_variant_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['ACTIVE'::text, 'CONVERTED'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_ci_uq ON public.users USING btree (lower(email))
